group.title: Workshop access notice
group.passage:
NORTHBANK MAKER SPACE
Notice to evening members — May 6

The lock on the riverside entrance will be replaced on Thursday, May 9. From 5 p.m. until closing, please enter through the courtyard gate beside the bicycle racks. Your current membership card will open this gate; you do not need to collect a temporary key. The riverside entrance will reopen at 9 a.m. on Friday.

Thursday's furniture-repair workshop will run at its usual time in Room 2. However, anyone bringing a bulky item should arrive before 5 p.m., since the courtyard passage is too narrow for large furniture. If you cannot arrive early, email reception by Wednesday noon. Staff can arrange to move your item inside earlier that day. The materials counter will close at 4:30 p.m., so workshop participants should reserve any supplies in advance.
group.passageZh:
NORTHBANK 創客空間
晚間時段會員公告：五月六日

河岸入口的門鎖將於五月九日星期四更換。當天下午五點至閉館，請由自行車架旁的庭院門進入。現有會員卡即可開門，不必領取臨時鑰匙。河岸入口將於星期五上午九點重新開放。

星期四的家具修復課照常在第二教室舉行。但攜帶大型物品者應於下午五點前抵達，因庭院通道太窄，無法通過大型家具。若無法提早抵達，請最遲於星期三中午寄電子郵件給櫃檯。工作人員可安排於上課當日稍早將物品搬入。材料櫃檯下午四點半關閉，學員應事先預訂所需材料。
